high_level_description: This image captures a scene from St. Peter's Square in Vatican City, as indicated by the iconic architecture and the presence of the Swiss Guard. The setting is outdoors on a rainy day, evident from the wet ground and the numerous umbrellas being held by the crowd. People: A large crowd of people is gathered in the square, many holding colorful umbrellas to shield themselves from the rain. In the foreground, there is a group of Swiss Guards standing in formation. They are dressed in their traditional white uniforms with red sashes and helmets, which are characteristic of their attire.
